description: Every primitive-recursive numerical function, viewed as a partial function with its full domain, is total recursive.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.primitive_recursive_inclusion {n : ℕ}
  {f : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n → ℕ} (hf : Nat.Primrec' f) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.TotalRecursive
    (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift f)
